name: a star's centre is the only bridge and collects the rank
why: Leaves a, b and c cite hub, which cites nothing (a dangling note).

queries.why: Every pair of leaves has exactly one shortest path, through hub; normalised by the 3 pairs, hub scores 1.
hub's rank is spread over all 4 notes. leaf = 0.15/4 + 0.85*hub/4, hub = 0.15/4 + 0.85*(3*leaf + hub/4) and 3*leaf + hub = 1 give hub = 0.8875/1.6375.
With damping 0 every step is a random jump, so rank is uniform.
